translations.literal: Qi was the son of Chu;
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Qi was the son of Zhou Chu;

sentences.zh: 御，邵之子；

translations.literal: Mi was the son of Shao;
translations.idiomatic: Gu Mi was the son of Gu Shao;

sentences.zh: 卓，寧之曾孫也。

translations.literal: Zhuo was the great-grandson of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Gan Zhuo was the great-grandson of Gan Ning.

sentences.zh: 冰遣其將羌毒帥兵數萬拒玘，玘擊斬之。

translations.literal: Bing sent his general Qiang Du to lead tens of thousands of troops to resist Qi; Qi attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Bing sent his general Qiang Du to lead tens of thousands of troops against Zhou Qi. Qi attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 冰自臨淮退趨壽春。

translations.literal: Bing withdrew from Linhuai and hastened toward Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Bing withdrew from Linhuai and hastened toward Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 征東將軍劉准聞冰至，惶懼不知所為。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the East Liu Zhun heard Bing had arrived and was terrified, not knowing what to do.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Conquers the East Liu Zhun heard that Shi Bing had arrived and was terrified, not knowing what to do.

sentences.zh: 廣陵度支廬江陳敏統眾在壽春，謂准曰：「此等本不樂遠戍，逼迫成賊，烏合之眾，其勢易離，敏請督帥運兵為公破之。」

translations.literal: Chen Min of Guangling, Transport Commissioner of Lujiang, was in command of troops at Shouchun. He said to Zhun, "These men never wanted to serve far from home; forced into rebellion they became bandits. A mob gathered in haste is easily split—I ask to command the transport troops for you and break them."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Min of Guangling, transport commissioner of Lujiang, was in command of troops at Shouchun. He said to Liu Zhun, "These men never wanted to serve far from home. Forced into rebellion, they became bandits. A mob gathered in haste is easily split. I ask to command the transport troops for you and break them."

sentences.zh: 准乃益敏兵，使擊之。

translations.literal: Zhun thereupon reinforced Min's troops and sent him to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhun thereupon reinforced Chen Min's troops and sent him to attack.

sentences.zh: 閏月，李雄急攻羅尚。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, Li Xiong pressed the attack on Luo Shang vigorously.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, Li Xiong pressed the attack on Luo Shang vigorously.

sentences.zh: 尚軍無食，留牙門張羅守城。

translations.literal: Shang's army had no food; he left Ya-men Zhang Luo to hold the city.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shang's army had no food. He left the ya-men officer Zhang Luo to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 夜，由牛鞞水東走，羅開門降。

translations.literal: At night he fled east along the Niupi River; Zhang opened the gates and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: At night Luo Shang fled east along the Niupi River. Zhang Luo opened the gates and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 雄入成都，軍士饑甚，乃帥眾就谷於郪，掘野芋而食之。

translations.literal: Xiong entered Chengdu; the soldiers were extremely hungry, so he led the multitude to forage grain at Qi, digging wild taro to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiong entered Chengdu. The soldiers were starving, so he led the multitude to forage grain at Qi and dug wild taro to eat.

sentences.zh: 許雄坐討賊不進，征即罪。

translations.literal: Xu Xiong was charged with failing to advance against the rebels and was summoned and punished upon arrival.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xiong was charged with failing to advance against the rebels and was summoned to the capital and punished upon arrival.

sentences.zh: 安北將軍、都督幽州諸軍事王濬，以天下方亂，欲結援夷狄，乃以一女妻鮮卑段務勿塵，一女妻素怒延，又表以遼西郡封務勿塵為遼西公。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North and Commander-in-Chief of Military Affairs for You Province Wang Jun, seeing the realm in turmoil, wished to secure allies among the barbarians; he gave one daughter in marriage to the Xianbei leader Duan Wuyichen and another to Sunuyan, and also memorialized to enfeoff Wuyichen as Duke of Liaoxi with Liaoxi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the North and commander-in-chief of military affairs for You Province Wang Jun, seeing the realm in turmoil, wished to secure allies among the barbarians. He gave one daughter in marriage to the Xianbei leader Duan Wuyichen and another to Sunuyan, and also memorialized to enfeoff Wuyichen as Duke of Liaoxi with Liaoxi Commandery.

sentences.zh: 濬，沈之子也。

translations.literal: Jun was the son of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun was the son of Wang Shen.

sentences.zh: 毛詵之死也，李睿奔五苓夷帥於陵丞，於陵丞詣李毅為睿請命，毅許之。

translations.literal: When Mao Shen died, Li Rui fled to the Wuling Yi chieftain Yu Lingcheng; Yu Lingcheng went to Li Yi to plead for Rui's life, and Yi agreed.
translations.idiomatic: When Mao Shen died, Li Rui fled to the Wuling Yi chieftain Yu Lingcheng. Yu Lingcheng went to Li Yi to plead for Rui's life, and Yi agreed.

sentences.zh: 睿至，毅殺之。

translations.literal: When Rui arrived, Yi killed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Rui arrived, Li Yi killed him.

sentences.zh: 於陵丞怒，帥諸夷反攻毅。

translations.literal: Yu Lingcheng was enraged and led the various Yi in a counterattack against Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lingcheng was enraged and led the various Yi in a counterattack against Li Yi.

sentences.zh: 尚書令樂廣女為成都王妃，或譖諸太尉乂；

translations.literal: Minister Over the Masses Le Guang's daughter was consort to the Prince of Chengdu; someone slandered this to Grand Marshal Yi;
translations.idiomatic: Minister Over the Masses Le Guang's daughter was consort to the Prince of Chengdu. Someone slandered this to Grand Marshal Sima Yi;

sentences.zh: 乂以問廣，廣神色不動，徐曰：「廣豈以五男易一女哉！」

translations.literal: Yi questioned Guang about it; Guang's expression did not change as he said slowly, "Would Guang trade five sons for one daughter!"
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yi questioned Le Guang about it. Guang's expression did not change as he said slowly, "Would Le Guang trade five sons for one daughter!"

sentences.zh: 乂猶疑之。

translations.literal: Yi still harbored doubts.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yi still harbored doubts.

sentences.zh: 孝惠皇帝中之下永興元年（

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaohui, middle section, lower part, first year of Yongxing (
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaohui, middle section, lower part, first year of Yongxing (

sentences.zh: 甲子，公元三零四年）

translations.literal: jiazi, AD 304)
translations.idiomatic: jiazi, AD 304)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丙午，樂廣以憂卒。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on day bingwu, Le Guang died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on day bingwu, Le Guang died of grief.

sentences.zh: 長沙厲王乂屢與大將軍穎戰，破之，前後斬獲六、七萬人。

translations.literal: Prince of Changsha the Resolute, Yi, fought repeatedly with Grand General Ying and defeated him; in all, sixty or seventy thousand were killed or captured.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Changsha the Resolute, Sima Yi, fought repeatedly with Grand General Sima Ying and defeated him. In all, sixty or seventy thousand were killed or captured.

sentences.zh: 而乂未嘗虧奉上之禮；

translations.literal: Yet Yi never once failed in his duty toward the throne;
translations.idiomatic: Yet Sima Yi never once failed in his duty toward the throne;

sentences.zh: 城中糧食日窘，而士卒無離心。

translations.literal: provisions in the city grew daily more scarce, but the soldiers had no thought of desertion.
translations.idiomatic: provisions in the city grew daily more scarce, but the soldiers had no thought of desertion.

sentences.zh: 張方以為洛陽未可克，欲還長安。

translations.literal: Zhang Fang judged that Luoyang could not be taken and wished to return to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang judged that Luoyang could not be taken and wished to return to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 而東海王越慮事不濟，癸亥，潛與殿中諸將夜收乂送別省。

translations.literal: But the Prince of Donghai, Yue, feared the affair would not succeed; on day guihai he secretly joined with the palace generals at night to seize Yi and send him to a separate residence.
translations.idiomatic: But the Prince of Donghai, Sima Yue, feared the affair would not succeed. On day guihai he secretly joined with the palace generals at night to seize Sima Yi and send him to a separate residence.

sentences.zh: 甲子，越啟帝，下詔免乂官，置金墉城。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Yue reported to the emperor; an edict was issued removing Yi from office and confining him at Jincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On day jiazi, Sima Yue reported to the emperor. An edict was issued removing Sima Yi from office and confining him at Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was declared and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 城既開，殿中將士見外兵不盛，悔之，更謀劫出乂以拒穎。

translations.literal: Once the city gates were opened, the palace generals saw that the outside forces were not strong and repented; they again plotted to seize Yi and use him to resist Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Once the city gates were opened, the palace generals saw that the outside forces were not strong and repented. They again plotted to seize Sima Yi and use him to resist Sima Ying.

sentences.zh: 越懼，欲殺乂以絕眾心。

translations.literal: Yue was afraid and wished to kill Yi to cut off the soldiers' hope.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yue was afraid and wished to kill Sima Yi to cut off the soldiers' hope.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎潘滔曰：「不可，將自有靜之者。」

translations.literal: Yellow Gate Attendant Pan Tao said, "You cannot; soon there will be someone to quiet them."
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Gate Attendant Pan Tao said, "You cannot. Soon there will be someone to quiet them."

sentences.zh: 乃遣密告張方。

translations.literal: He then sent a secret message to Zhang Fang.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent a secret message to Zhang Fang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，方取乂於金墉城，至營，炙而殺之，方軍士亦為之流涕。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Fang took Yi from Jincheng; when he reached camp he burned him alive and killed him, and Fang's soldiers also wept for him.
translations.idiomatic: On day bingyin, Zhang Fang took Sima Yi from Jincheng. When he reached camp he burned him alive and killed him, and Fang's soldiers also wept for him.

sentences.zh: 公卿皆詣鄴謝罪；

translations.literal: The nobles and ministers all went to Ye to apologize;
translations.idiomatic: The nobles and ministers all went to Ye to apologize;

sentences.zh: 大將軍穎入京師，復還鎮於鄴。

translations.literal: Grand General Ying entered the capital and then returned to hold his post at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Sima Ying entered the capital and then returned to hold his post at Ye.

sentences.zh: 詔以穎為丞相，加東海王越守尚書令。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Ying Grand Chancellor and added the Prince of Donghai Yue as Acting Minister Over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Sima Ying grand chancellor and added the Prince of Donghai Sima Yue as acting minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 穎遣奮武將軍石超等帥兵五萬屯十二城門，殿中宿所忌者，穎皆殺之；

translations.literal: Ying sent Vigorous Martial General Shi Chao and others to command fifty thousand troops stationed at the twelve city gates; palace guards Ying feared or resented, he had them all killed;
translations.idiomatic: Sima Ying sent Vigorous Martial General Shi Chao and others to command fifty thousand troops stationed at the twelve city gates. Palace guards Ying feared or resented, he had them all killed;

sentences.zh: 悉代去宿衛兵。

translations.literal: He replaced all the palace guard troops entirely.
translations.idiomatic: He replaced all the palace guard troops entirely.

sentences.zh: 表盧志為中書監，留鄴，參署丞相府事。

translations.literal: He memorialized to appoint Lu Zhi as Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, keeping him at Ye to assist in the grand chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to appoint Lu Zhi supervisor of the masters of writing, keeping him at Ye to assist in the grand chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 河間王顒頓軍於鄭，為東軍聲援，聞劉沈兵起，還鎮渭城，遣督護虞遵夔逆戰於好畦。

translations.literal: Prince of Hejian Yong encamped at Zheng to support the eastern army; hearing Liu Shen's forces had risen, he returned to hold Weicheng and sent Supervisor Yu Zunkui to meet the enemy in battle at Haoqi.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Hejian, Sima Yong, encamped at Zheng to support the eastern army. Hearing that Liu Shen's forces had risen, he returned to hold Weicheng and sent supervisor Yu Zunkui to meet the enemy in battle at Haoqi.

sentences.zh: 夔兵敗，顒懼，退入長安，急召張方。

translations.literal: Zunkui's army was defeated; Yong was afraid, withdrew into Chang'an, and urgently summoned Zhang Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zunkui's army was defeated. Sima Yong was afraid, withdrew into Chang'an, and urgently summoned Zhang Fang.

sentences.zh: 方掠洛中官私奴婢萬餘人而西。

translations.literal: Fang plundered more than ten thousand palace and private male and female slaves from Luoyang and marched west.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang plundered more than ten thousand palace and private male and female slaves from Luoyang and marched west.

sentences.zh: 軍中乏食，殺人雜牛馬肉食之。

translations.literal: The army lacked food; they killed people and mixed the flesh with cattle and horse meat to eat it.
translations.idiomatic: The army lacked food. They killed people and mixed the flesh with cattle and horse meat to eat it.

sentences.zh: 劉沈渡渭而軍，與顒戰，顒屢敗。

translations.literal: Liu Shen crossed the Wei and encamped, fought with Yong, and Yong was repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shen crossed the Wei and encamped. He fought with Sima Yong, and Yong was repeatedly defeated.

sentences.zh: 沈使安定太守衙博、功曹皇甫澹以精甲五千襲長安，入其門，力戰至顒帳下。

translations.literal: Shen sent Ding'an Administrator Ya Bo and Registrar Huangfu Dan with five thousand elite armored troops to raid Chang'an; they entered the gates and fought fiercely as far as Yong's headquarters tent.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shen sent Ding'an Administrator Ya Bo and registrar Huangfu Dan with five thousand elite armored troops to raid Chang'an. They entered the gates and fought fiercely as far as Sima Yong's headquarters tent.

sentences.zh: 沈兵來遲，馮翊太守張輔見其無繼，引兵橫擊之，殺博及澹，沈兵遂敗，收餘卒而退。

translations.literal: Shen's main force arrived late; Fengyi Administrator Zhang Fu saw they had no reinforcements and led troops in a flank attack, killing Bo and Dan; Shen's army was defeated and gathered the remaining troops to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shen's main force arrived late. Fengyi Administrator Zhang Fu saw they had no reinforcements and led troops in a flank attack, killing Ya Bo and Huangfu Dan. Liu Shen's army was defeated and gathered the remaining troops to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 張方遣其將敦偉夜擊之，沈軍驚潰，沈與麾下南走，追獲之。

translations.literal: Zhang Fang sent his general Dun Wei to attack by night; Shen's army panicked and fled; Shen fled south with his followers and was captured in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang sent his general Dun Wei to attack by night. Liu Shen's army panicked and fled. Shen fled south with his followers and was captured in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 沈謂顒曰：「知己之惠輕，君臣之義重，沈不可以違天子之詔，量強弱以苟全。

translations.literal: Shen said to Yong, "The kindness of a friend is light; the duty between ruler and subject is heavy. Shen cannot disobey the Son of Heaven's edict and measure strength and weakness to seek mere survival.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shen said to Sima Yong, "The kindness of a friend is light; the duty between ruler and subject is heavy. I cannot disobey the Son of Heaven's edict and measure strength and weakness merely to save myself.

sentences.zh: 投袂之日，期之必死，菹醯之戮，其甘如薺。」

translations.literal: From the day I threw up my sleeve to act, I expected death; to be chopped and pickled—I would find it sweet as shepherd's purse."
translations.idiomatic: From the day I threw up my sleeve to act, I expected death. To be chopped and pickled—I would find it sweet as shepherd's purse."

sentences.zh: 顒怒，鞭之而後腰斬。

translations.literal: Yong was enraged; he flogged Shen and then executed him by cutting at the waist.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yong was enraged. He flogged Liu Shen and then executed him by cutting at the waist.

sentences.zh: 新平太守江夏張光數為沈畫計，顒執而詰之，光曰：「劉雍州不用鄙計，故令王得有今日！」

translations.literal: Xinping Administrator Zhang Guang of Jiangxia had repeatedly devised plans for Shen; Yong seized and interrogated him. Guang said, "The Liu of Yong Province did not use my humble plans—that is why Your Highness enjoys today!"
translations.idiomatic: Xinping Administrator Zhang Guang of Jiangxia had repeatedly devised plans for Liu Shen. Sima Yong seized and interrogated him. Guang said, "The Liu of Yong Province did not use my humble plans—that is why Your Highness enjoys today!"

sentences.zh: 顒壯之。

translations.literal: Yong admired his spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yong admired his spirit.

sentences.zh: 引與歡宴，表為右衛司馬。

translations.literal: He invited him to a feast of fellowship and memorialized to appoint him Right Guard Major.
translations.idiomatic: He invited him to a feast of fellowship and memorialized to appoint him right guard major.

sentences.zh: 羅尚逃至江陽，遣使表狀，詔尚權統巴東、巴郡、涪陵以供軍賦。

translations.literal: Luo Shang fled to Jiangyang, sent envoys with a memorial of his situation; an edict authorized Shang provisionally to govern Badong, Ba, and Fuling commanderies to supply military levies.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shang fled to Jiangyang and sent envoys with a memorial of his situation. An edict authorized him provisionally to govern Badong, Ba, and Fuling commanderies to supply military levies.

sentences.zh: 尚遣別駕李興詣鎮南將軍劉弘求糧，弘綱紀以運道阻遠，且荊州自空乏，欲以零陵米五千斛與尚。

translations.literal: Shang sent Assistant Director Li Xing to call on General Who Guards the South Liu Hong to request grain. Hong's staff, citing blocked and distant transport routes and Jing province's own shortages, wished to give Shang only five thousand hu of Lingling rice.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shang sent his Assistant Director Li Xing to call on the General Who Guards the South, Liu Hong, to request grain. Hong's staff, citing the blocked and distant supply routes and Jing province's own shortages, proposed giving Shang only five thousand hu of Lingling rice.

sentences.zh: 弘曰：「天下一家，彼此無異，吾今給之，則無西顧之憂矣。」

translations.literal: Hong said, "All under Heaven is one family; there is no difference between us. If I supply you now, you will have no worry of looking westward."
translations.idiomatic: Hong said, "All under Heaven is one family; there is no difference between us. If I supply you now, you will have no need to worry about your rear to the west."

sentences.zh: 遂以三萬斛結之，尚賴以自存。

translations.literal: He thereupon settled on thirty thousand hu for him; Shang relied on this to survive.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon provided thirty thousand hu, and Shang relied on this to survive.

sentences.zh: 李興願留為弘參軍，弘奪其手版而遣之。

translations.literal: Li Xing wished to remain and serve Hong as a staff officer; Hong snatched away his credentials and sent him off.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xing wished to remain and serve as Hong's staff officer, but Hong snatched away his credentials and sent him back.

sentences.zh: 又遣治中何松領兵屯巴東為尚後繼。

translations.literal: He also sent Director of Arrangements He Song to lead troops and garrison Badong as Shang's rear support.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Director of Arrangements He Song to lead troops and garrison Badong as Shang's reserve force.

sentences.zh: 於時流民有荊州者十餘萬戶，羈旅貧乏，多為盜賊，弘大給其田及種糧，擢其賢才，隨資敘用，流民遂安。

translations.literal: At that time there were more than one hundred thousand displaced households from Jing province, impoverished in their wandering exile and many turning to banditry. Hong greatly provided them with fields and seed grain, promoted the worthy and talented, and employed them according to their capacities; the displaced people were thus settled.
translations.idiomatic: At that time more than one hundred thousand displaced households from Jing province were living in poverty as wanderers, and many turned to banditry. Hong generously granted them fields and seed grain, promoted the worthy among them, and employed each according to his capacity, and the displaced people were thus settled.

sentences.zh: 二月，乙酉，丞相穎表廢皇后羊氏，幽於金墉城，廢皇太子覃為清河王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiyou, Chancellor Ying memorialized to depose Empress Yang, who was confined at Jinyong city, and demoted Crown Prince Tan to Prince of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day yiyou, Chancellor Sima Ying memorialized to depose Empress Yang, who was confined at Jinyong city, and demoted Crown Prince Tan to Prince of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 陳敏與石冰戰數十合，冰眾十倍於敏，敏擊之，所向皆捷，遂與周玘合攻冰於建康。

translations.literal: Chen Min fought with Shi Bing in dozens of engagements. Bing's forces were ten times those of Min, but Min struck them and wherever he went victory followed; he then joined Zhou Qi in a joint attack on Bing at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Min fought Shi Bing in dozens of engagements. Bing's forces outnumbered Min's tenfold, yet Min struck them and carried every field before him; he then joined Zhou Qi in a joint assault on Bing at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 三月，冰北走，投封雲，雲司馬張統斬冰及雲以降，揚、徐二州平。

translations.literal: In the third month, Bing fled north and went over to Feng Yun. Yun's Chief Administrator Zhang Tong beheaded Bing and Yun and surrendered; Yang and Xu provinces were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Bing fled north and went over to Feng Yun. Yun's Chief Administrator Zhang Tong beheaded both Bing and Yun and surrendered; Yang and Xu provinces were pacified.

sentences.zh: 周玘、賀循皆散眾還家，不言功賞。

translations.literal: Zhou Qi and He Xun both dismissed their forces and returned home, saying nothing of merit or reward.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Qi and He Xun both dismissed their troops and returned home, making no mention of merit or reward.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以陳敏為廣陵相。

translations.literal: The court appointed Chen Min Administrator of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Chen Min Administrator of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 河間王顒表請立丞相穎為太弟。

translations.literal: The Prince of Hejian, Yong, memorialized asking that Chancellor Ying be established as Grand Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Hejian, Sima Yong, memorialized asking that Chancellor Sima Ying be established as Grand Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔以穎為皇太弟，都督中外諸軍事，丞相如故。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict appointed Ying Grand Heir Apparent, with command over all military affairs at home and abroad; he remained Chancellor as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, an edict appointed Sima Ying Grand Heir Apparent, with command over all military affairs at home and abroad, while he remained Chancellor as before.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乘輿服御皆遷於鄴，制度一如魏武帝故事。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage, robes, and accoutrements were all transferred to Ye, with regulations modeled entirely on the precedents of Emperor Wu of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage, robes, and accoutrements were all transferred to Ye, with regulations modeled entirely on the precedents of Emperor Wu of Wei.

sentences.zh: 以顒為大宰、大都督、雍州牧；

translations.literal: Yong was appointed Grand Mentor, Grand Commander, and Governor of Yong province;
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yong was appointed Grand Mentor, Grand Commander, and Governor of Yong province;

sentences.zh: 前太傅劉實為太尉。

translations.literal: the former Grand Tutor Liu Shi was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: the former Grand Tutor Liu Shi was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 實以老，固讓不拜。

translations.literal: Shi, being old, firmly declined and would not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Shi, being old, firmly declined and refused to accept the appointment.

sentences.zh: 太弟穎僭侈日甚，劈幸用事，大失眾望。

translations.literal: Grand Heir Apparent Ying grew more extravagant by the day; favored sycophants held power, and he lost the people's hopes sorely.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Heir Apparent Sima Ying grew more extravagant by the day; favored sycophants held power, and he lost the people's hopes sorely.

sentences.zh: 司空東海王越，與右衛將軍陳眕，及長沙王故將上官已等謀討之。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses, the Prince of Donghai, Yue, together with Guard General of the Right Chen Zhen and former generals of the Prince of Changsha, Shangguan Yi and others, plotted to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses Sima Yue, the Prince of Donghai, together with Guard General of the Right Chen Zhen and former generals of the Prince of Changsha, Shangguan Yi and others, plotted to punish him.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，丙申朔，陳眕勒兵入雲龍門，以詔召三公百僚及殿中，戒嚴討穎，石超奔鄴。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day of the month bingshen, Chen Zhen drew up troops and entered the Cloud Dragon Gate, summoning the Three Excellencies, the hundred officials, and the palace guard by edict to enforce martial law and punish Ying; Shi Chao fled to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day bingshen, Chen Zhen drew up his troops and entered the Cloud Dragon Gate. By edict he summoned the Three Excellencies, the hundred officials, and the palace guard to enforce martial law and punish Ying; Shi Chao fled to Ye.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦，復皇后羊氏及太子覃。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed, restoring Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed, restoring Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，越奉帝北征。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Yue escorted the emperor on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Sima Yue escorted the emperor on a northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 以越為大都督。

translations.literal: Yue was appointed Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yue was appointed Grand Commander.

sentences.zh: 征前侍中嵇紹詣行在。

translations.literal: The former Palace Attendant Ji Shao was summoned to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: The former Palace Attendant Ji Shao was summoned to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 侍中秦准謂紹曰：「今往，安危難測，卿有佳馬乎？」

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Qin Zhun said to Shao, "If you go now, safety and danger are hard to measure—do you have a fine horse?"
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Qin Zhun said to Shao, "If you go now, safety and danger are impossible to foretell—do you have a fine horse?"

sentences.zh: 紹正色曰：「臣子扈衛乘輿，死生以之，佳馬何為！」

translations.literal: Shao said sternly, "A minister and son guards the imperial carriage; life and death follow from that—what need is there for a fine horse!"
translations.idiomatic: Shao said sternly, "A minister and son guards the imperial carriage; life and death follow from that—what need is there for a fine horse!"

sentences.zh: 越檄召四方兵，赴者雲集，比至安陽，眾十餘萬，鄴中震恐。

translations.literal: Yue issued proclamations summoning troops from all quarters; those who came gathered like clouds. By the time they reached Anyang, their numbers exceeded one hundred thousand, and Ye was shaken with terror.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yue issued proclamations summoning troops from all quarters, and those who came gathered like clouds. By the time they reached Anyang, their numbers exceeded one hundred thousand, and Ye was shaken with terror.

sentences.zh: 穎會群僚問計，東安王繇曰：「天子親征，宜釋甲縞素出迎請罪。」

translations.literal: Ying assembled the officials and asked for counsel. The Prince of Dong'an, Yao, said, "The Son of Heaven is campaigning in person; you should lay down arms, wear white mourning, and go out to welcome him and plead guilty."
translations.idiomatic: Ying assembled the officials and asked for counsel. The Prince of Dong'an, Sima Yao, said, "The Son of Heaven is campaigning in person; you should lay down your arms, wear white mourning, and go out to welcome him and plead guilty."

sentences.zh: 穎不從，遣石超帥眾五萬拒戰。

translations.literal: Ying did not agree and sent Shi Chao to lead fifty thousand men to resist in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Ying did not agree and sent Shi Chao to lead fifty thousand men to resist in battle.

sentences.zh: 折衝將軍喬智明勸穎奉迎乘輿，穎怒曰：「卿名曉事，投身事孤；

translations.literal: General Who Breaks the Charge Qiao Zhiming urged Ying to welcome the imperial carriage. Ying raged and said, "Your name means 'understands affairs'—you gave yourself to serve me;
translations.idiomatic: General Who Breaks the Charge Qiao Zhiming urged Ying to welcome the imperial carriage. Ying raged and said, "Your name means 'understands affairs'—you gave yourself to serve me;

sentences.zh: 今主上為群小所逼，卿奈何欲使孤束手就刑邪！」

translations.literal: now the sovereign is driven by petty men, yet how can you want to make me submit and accept punishment!"
translations.idiomatic: now the sovereign is driven by petty men, yet how can you want to make me submit and accept punishment!"

sentences.zh: 陳眕二弟匡、規自鄴赴行在，-{云}-鄴中皆已離散，由是不甚設備。

translations.literal: Chen Zhen's two younger brothers Kuang and Gui came from Ye to the imperial camp; they reported that Ye had already fallen apart internally, and for that reason [the imperial forces] did not prepare their defenses very thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhen's two younger brothers Kuang and Gui came from Ye to the imperial camp; they reported that Ye had already fallen apart internally, and for that reason the imperial forces did not prepare their defenses very thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 己未，石超軍奄至，乘輿敗績於蕩陰，帝傷頰，中三矢，百官侍御皆散。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Shi Chao's army arrived suddenly. The imperial carriage was defeated at Dangyin; the emperor was wounded in the cheek and struck by three arrows, and the hundred officials and attendants all scattered.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, Shi Chao's army arrived suddenly. The imperial forces were defeated at Dangyin; the emperor was wounded in the cheek and struck by three arrows, and the hundred officials and attendants all scattered.

sentences.zh: 嵇紹朝服，下馬登輦，以身衛帝，兵人引紹於轅中斫之。

translations.literal: Ji Shao, in court dress, dismounted and boarded the carriage to shield the emperor with his body; soldiers pulled Shao into the carriage shaft and hacked at him.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Shao, in court dress, dismounted and boarded the carriage to shield the emperor with his body; soldiers pulled Shao into the carriage shaft and hacked at him.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「忠臣也，勿殺！」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "A loyal minister—do not kill him!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "A loyal minister—do not kill him!"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「奉太弟令，惟不犯陛下一人耳！」

translations.literal: They replied, "We act on the Grand Heir Apparent's order—we may offend all except Your Majesty alone!"
translations.idiomatic: They replied, "We act on the Grand Heir Apparent's order—we may offend all except Your Majesty alone!"

sentences.zh: 遂殺紹。

translations.literal: They then killed Shao.
translations.idiomatic: They then killed Shao.

sentences.zh: 血濺帝衣。

translations.literal: Blood splashed the emperor's robes.
translations.idiomatic: Blood splashed the emperor's robes.

sentences.zh: 帝墮於草中，亡六璽。

translations.literal: The emperor fell into the grass and lost the six seals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fell into the grass and lost the six imperial seals.

sentences.zh: 石超奉帝幸其營，帝餒甚，超進水，左右奉秋桃。

translations.literal: Shi Chao escorted the emperor to his camp. The emperor was very hungry; Chao offered water, and attendants presented autumn peaches.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Chao escorted the emperor to his camp. The emperor was famished; Chao offered him water, and attendants presented autumn peaches.

sentences.zh: 穎遣盧志迎帝；

translations.literal: Ying sent Lu Zhi to welcome the emperor;
translations.idiomatic: Ying sent Lu Zhi to welcome the emperor;

sentences.zh: 庚申，入鄴。

translations.literal: on the day gengshen, [the emperor] entered Ye.
translations.idiomatic: on the day gengshen, the emperor entered Ye.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元曰建武。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Jianwu.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Jianwu.

sentences.zh: 左右欲浣帝衣。

translations.literal: Attendants wished to wash the emperor's robes.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants wished to wash the emperor's robes.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「嵇侍中血，勿浣也！」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "That is Attendant Ji's blood—do not wash it!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "That is Attendant Ji's blood—do not wash it!"

sentences.zh: 陳眕、上官巳等奉太子覃守洛陽。

translations.literal: Chen Zhen, Shangguan Yi, and others escorted Crown Prince Tan to hold Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhen, Shangguan Yi, and others escorted Crown Prince Tan to hold Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 司空越奔下邳，徐州都督東平王楙不納，越徑還東海。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Yue fled to Xiapi; the Commander of Xu province, the Prince of Dongping, Mao, would not receive him, and Yue went straight back to Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses Sima Yue fled to Xiapi; the Commander of Xu province, the Prince of Dongping, Sima Mao, would not receive him, and Yue went straight back to Donghai.

sentences.zh: 太弟穎以越兄北弟宗室之望，下令招之，越不應命。

translations.literal: Grand Heir Apparent Ying, because Yue enjoyed the greatest prestige among the imperial clansmen in the north, issued orders summoning him—but Yue did not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Heir Apparent Sima Ying, because Sima Yue enjoyed the greatest prestige among the imperial clansmen in the north, issued orders summoning him—but Yue did not obey.

sentences.zh: 前奮威將軍孫惠上書勸越邀結籓方，同獎王室。

translations.literal: Former General Who Displays Might Sun Hui submitted a memorial urging Yue to invite and unite the frontier regions and jointly support the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Former General Who Displays Might Sun Hui submitted a memorial urging Yue to rally the frontier regions and jointly support the royal house.

sentences.zh: 越以惠為記室參軍，與參謀議。

translations.literal: Yue appointed Hui Recorder of the Headquarters and consulted with him on strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Yue appointed Sun Hui Recorder of the Headquarters and consulted with him on strategy.

sentences.zh: 北軍中候苟晞奔范陽王虓，虓承制以晞行兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Commandant of the Northern Army Gou Xi fled to the Prince of Fanyang, Xiao; Xiao, acting on imperial authority, appointed Xi acting Inspector of Yan province.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant of the Northern Army Gou Xi fled to the Prince of Fanyang, Sima Xiao; Xiao, acting on imperial authority, appointed Xi acting Inspector of Yan province.

sentences.zh: 初，三王之起兵討趙王倫也，王浚擁眾挾兩端，禁所部士民不得赴三王召募。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the three princes raised troops to punish the Prince of Zhao, Lun, Wang Jun held his forces and straddled both sides, forbidding the soldiers and people under his command to answer the three princes' recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the three princes raised troops to punish the Prince of Zhao, Sima Lun, Wang Jun held his forces and straddled both sides, forbidding the soldiers and people under his command to answer the three princes' recruitment.

sentences.zh: 太弟穎欲討之而未能，濬心亦欲圖穎。

translations.literal: Grand Heir Apparent Ying wished to punish him but could not; Jun in his heart also wished to plot against Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Heir Apparent Ying wished to punish him but could not; Wang Jun in his heart also wished to plot against Ying.

sentences.zh: 穎以右司馬和演為幽州刺史，密使殺浚。

translations.literal: Ying appointed He Yan Right Chief Marshal and Governor of You province, secretly ordering him to kill Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Ying appointed He Yan Right Chief Marshal and Governor of You province, secretly ordering him to kill Wang Jun.

sentences.zh: 演與烏桓單于審登謀與浚游薊城南清泉，因而圖之。

translations.literal: Yan plotted with the Wuhuan Chanyu Shen Deng to invite Jun to stroll by the Clear Spring south of Ji city and seize the opportunity to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: He Yan plotted with the Wuhuan Chanyu Shen Deng to invite Wang Jun to stroll by the Clear Spring south of Ji city and seize the opportunity to kill him.

sentences.zh: 會天暴雨，兵器沾濕，不果而還。

translations.literal: Just then heaven sent a torrential rain; weapons were soaked through, and the plan came to nothing and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: Just then a torrential rain fell; weapons were soaked through, the plan came to nothing, and they returned.

sentences.zh: 審登以為浚得天助，乃以演謀告浚。

translations.literal: Shen Deng thought Jun had received Heaven's aid and therefore told Jun of Yan's plot.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Deng thought Wang Jun had received Heaven's aid and therefore told Jun of He Yan's plot.

sentences.zh: 浚與審登密嚴兵，約并州刺史東贏公騰共圍演，殺之，自領幽州營兵。

translations.literal: Jun and Shen Deng secretly marshaled troops, arranged with the Inspector of Bing province, the Duke of Dongying, Teng, to surround Yan jointly, killed him, and Jun himself took command of the You province garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun and Shen Deng secretly marshaled troops, arranged with the Inspector of Bing province, the Duke of Dongying, Sima Teng, to surround He Yan jointly, killed him, and Jun himself took command of the You province garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 騰，越之弟也。

translations.literal: Teng was Yue's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Teng was Sima Yue's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 太弟穎稱詔征浚，浚與鮮卑段務勿塵、烏桓羯朱及東嬴公騰同起兵討穎，穎遣北中郎將王斌及石超擊之。

translations.literal: Grand Heir Apparent Ying, in the emperor's name, ordered a campaign against Jun. Jun, together with the Xianbei leader Duan Wuwuchen, the Wuhuan leader Jiezhu, and the Duke of Dongying, Teng, raised troops jointly to punish Ying. Ying sent General of the Household for the North Wang Bin and Shi Chao to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Heir Apparent Ying, in the emperor's name, ordered a campaign against Wang Jun. Jun, together with the Xianbei leader Duan Wuwuchen, the Wuhuan leader Jiezhu, and the Duke of Dongying, Sima Teng, raised troops jointly to punish Ying. Ying sent General of the Household for the North Wang Bin and Shi Chao to strike them.

sentences.zh: 太弟穎怨東安王繇前議，八月，戊辰，收繇，殺之。

translations.literal: Grand Heir Apparent Ying resented the Prince of Dong'an, Yao, for his earlier counsel. In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, he arrested Yao and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Heir Apparent Ying resented the Prince of Dong'an, Sima Yao, for his earlier counsel. In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, he arrested Yao and killed him.

sentences.zh: 初，繇兄琅邪恭王覲薨，子睿嗣。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yao's elder brother, the Respectful Prince of Langye, Jing, had died, and his son Rui succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yao's elder brother, the Respectful Prince of Langye, Sima Jing, had died, and his son Rui succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 睿沈敏有度量，為左將軍，與東海參軍王導善。

translations.literal: Rui was deep and keen, with breadth of character; he served as General of the Left and was on good terms with Staff Officer Wang Dao of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Rui was deep and keen, with breadth of character; he served as General of the Left and was on good terms with Staff Officer Wang Dao of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 導，敦之從父弟也；

translations.literal: Dao was Dun's younger cousin;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dao was Wang Dun's younger cousin;

sentences.zh: 識量清遠，以朝廷多故，每勸睿之國。

translations.literal: his discernment was clear and far-reaching. Because the court was beset by many troubles, he often urged Rui to return to his fief.
translations.idiomatic: his discernment was clear and far-reaching. Because the court was beset by many troubles, he often urged Rui to return to his fief.

sentences.zh: 及繇死，睿從帝在鄴，恐及禍，將逃歸。

translations.literal: When Yao died, Rui was accompanying the emperor at Ye; fearing he would be caught up in disaster, he prepared to flee home.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao died, Rui was accompanying the emperor at Ye; fearing he would be caught up in disaster, he prepared to flee home.

sentences.zh: 穎先敕諸關津，無得出貴人；

translations.literal: Ying had already ordered all passes and fords that no person of rank was to be allowed out;
translations.idiomatic: Ying had already ordered all passes and fords that no person of rank was to be allowed out;

sentences.zh: 睿至河陽，為津吏所止。

translations.literal: when Rui reached Heyang, he was stopped by the ford officer.
translations.idiomatic: when Rui reached Heyang, he was stopped by the ford officer.

sentences.zh: 從者宋興自後來，以鞭拂睿而笑曰：「捨長，官禁貴人，汝亦被拘邪？」

translations.literal: His follower Song Xing came up from behind, brushed Rui with a whip, and laughed, "My lord, the authorities forbid persons of rank to pass—have you been detained as well?"
translations.idiomatic: His follower Song Xing came up from behind, brushed Rui with a whip, and laughed, "My lord, the authorities forbid persons of rank to pass—have you been detained as well?"

sentences.zh: 吏乃聽過。

translations.literal: The officer then allowed them to pass.
translations.idiomatic: The officer then allowed them to pass.

sentences.zh: 至洛陽，迎太妃夏侯氏俱歸國。

translations.literal: When they reached Luoyang, they welcomed the Princess Dowager, Lady Xiahou, and all returned to their fief together.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Luoyang, they welcomed the Princess Dowager, Lady Xiahou, and all returned to their fief together.

sentences.zh: 丞相從事中郎王澄發孟玖奸利事，勸太弟穎誅之，穎從之。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman of the Chancellor's Office Wang Cheng exposed Meng Jiu's corrupt profiteering and urged Grand Heir Apparent Ying to execute him; Ying agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman of the Chancellor's Office Wang Cheng exposed Meng Jiu's corrupt profiteering and urged Grand Heir Apparent Ying to execute him; Ying agreed.

sentences.zh: 上官巳在洛陽，殘暴縱橫。

translations.literal: Shangguan Yi was at Luoyang, brutal and unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: Shangguan Yi was at Luoyang, brutal and unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 守河南尹周馥，浚之從父弟也，與司隸滿奮等謀誅之。

translations.literal: The Administrator of Henan, Zhou Fu, was Jun's younger cousin; he plotted with Metropolitan Commandant Man Fen and others to kill Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The Administrator of Henan, Zhou Fu, was Wang Jun's younger cousin; he plotted with Metropolitan Commandant Man Fen and others to kill Shangguan Yi.

sentences.zh: 事洩，奮等死，馥走，得免。

translations.literal: The plot leaked out; Fen and the others died, while Fu fled and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: The plot leaked out; Fen and the others were killed, while Fu fled and escaped.

sentences.zh: 司空越之討太弟穎也，太宰顒遣右將軍、馮翊太守張方將兵二萬救之，聞帝已入鄴，因命方鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: When Minister over the Masses Yue marched to punish Grand Heir Apparent Ying, Grand Mentor Yong sent General of the Right and Administrator of Fufeng Zhang Fang with twenty thousand troops to rescue him. Hearing that the emperor had already entered Ye, he then ordered Fang to garrison Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister over the Masses Sima Yue marched to punish Grand Heir Apparent Ying, Grand Mentor Sima Yong sent General of the Right and Administrator of Fufeng Zhang Fang with twenty thousand troops to rescue him. Hearing that the emperor had already entered Ye, he then ordered Fang to garrison Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 巳與別將苗願拒之，大敗而還。

translations.literal: Yi and the separate commander Miao Yuan resisted him but suffered a great defeat and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shangguan Yi and the separate commander Miao Yuan resisted him but suffered a crushing defeat and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 太子覃夜襲巳、願，巳、願出走；

translations.literal: Crown Prince Tan launched a night attack on Yi and Yuan; Yi and Yuan fled;
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Tan launched a night attack on Yi and Yuan; Yi and Yuan fled;

sentences.zh: 方入洛陽。

translations.literal: and Fang entered Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: and Zhang Fang entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 覃於廣陽門迎方而拜，方下車扶止之。

translations.literal: Tan welcomed Fang at the Guangyang Gate and bowed to him; Fang dismounted and helped him up to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: Tan welcomed Fang at the Guangyang Gate and bowed to him; Fang dismounted and helped him up to stop him.

sentences.zh: 復廢覃及羊後。

translations.literal: Tan and Empress Yang were again deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Tan and Empress Yang were again deposed.

sentences.zh: 初，太弟穎表匈奴左賢王劉淵為冠軍將軍，監五部軍事，使將兵在鄴。

translations.literal: Earlier, Grand Heir Apparent Ying had memorialized appointing the Xiongnu Left Worthy King Liu Yuan General Who Establishes Victory, with oversight of the five tribes' military affairs, and ordered him to lead troops at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Grand Heir Apparent Ying had memorialized appointing the Xiongnu Left Worthy King Liu Yuan General Who Establishes Victory, with oversight of the five tribes' military affairs, and ordered him to lead troops at Ye.

sentences.zh: 淵子聰，驍勇絕人，博涉經史，善屬文，彎弓三百斤；

translations.literal: Yuan's son Cong was matchlessly brave and fierce, broadly versed in the classics and histories, skilled at literary composition, and could draw a bow of three hundred jin;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan's son Cong was matchlessly brave and fierce, broadly versed in the classics and histories, skilled at literary composition, and could draw a bow of three hundred jin;

sentences.zh: 弱冠游京師，名士莫不與交。

translations.literal: in his early twenties he traveled to the capital, and no eminent scholar failed to associate with him.
translations.idiomatic: in his early twenties he traveled to the capital, and no eminent scholar failed to associate with him.

sentences.zh: 穎以聰為積弩將軍。

translations.literal: Ying appointed Cong General of Accumulated Crossbows.
translations.idiomatic: Ying appointed Liu Cong General of Accumulated Crossbows.

sentences.zh: 淵從祖右賢王宣謂其族人曰：「自漢亡以來，我單于徒有虛號，無復尺土；

translations.literal: Yuan's distant uncle, the Right Worthy King Xuan, said to his clansmen, "Since the fall of Han, our Xiongnu rulers have borne only empty titles and hold not a foot of territory;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuan's distant uncle, the Right Worthy King Xuan, said to his clansmen, "Since the fall of Han, our Xiongnu rulers have borne only empty titles and hold not a foot of territory;

sentences.zh: 自餘王侯，降同編戶。

translations.literal: all other kings and marquises have been reduced to the same household registers as common people.
translations.idiomatic: all other kings and marquises have been reduced to the same household registers as common people.

sentences.zh: 今吾眾雖衰，猶不減二萬，奈何斂手受役，奄過百年！

translations.literal: Though our numbers have waned, we are still no fewer than twenty thousand—how can we fold our hands and submit to servitude, letting more than a century slip by!
translations.idiomatic: Though our numbers have waned, we are still no fewer than twenty thousand—how can we fold our hands and submit to servitude, letting more than a century slip by!

sentences.zh: 左賢王英武超世，天苟不欲興匈奴，必不虛生此人也。

translations.literal: The Left Worthy King is heroic and surpasses his age; if Heaven did not wish to raise the Xiongnu again, it would not have brought such a man into being without reason.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Worthy King is heroic and surpasses his age; if Heaven did not wish to raise the Xiongnu again, it would not have brought such a man into being without reason.

sentences.zh: 今司馬氏骨肉相殘，四海鼎沸，復呼韓邪之業，此其時矣！」

translations.literal: Now the Sima clan tear one another apart and all the realm boils—it is time to revive the enterprise of Huhanye!"
translations.idiomatic: Now the Sima clan tear one another apart and all the realm boils—it is time to revive the enterprise of Huhanye Chanyu!"

sentences.zh: 乃相與謀，推淵為大單于，使其黨呼延攸詣鄴告之。

translations.literal: They then plotted together, enthroning Yuan as Grand Chanyu, and sent his follower Huyan You to Ye to report it.
translations.idiomatic: They then plotted together, enthroning Liu Yuan as Grand Chanyu, and sent his follower Huyan You to Ye to report it.

sentences.zh: 淵白穎，請歸會葬，穎弗許。

translations.literal: Yuan informed Ying and asked to return for a funeral assembly; Ying did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuan informed Ying and asked to return for a funeral assembly; Ying did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 淵令攸先歸，告宣等使招集五部及雜胡，聲言助穎，實欲叛之。

translations.literal: Yuan ordered You to return first and tell Xuan and the others to gather the five tribes and various barbarian peoples, claiming they would aid Ying but in fact intending to rebel against him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan ordered Huyan You to return first and tell Xuan and the others to gather the five tribes and various barbarian peoples, claiming they would aid Ying but in fact intending to rebel against him.

sentences.zh: 及王浚、東嬴公騰起兵，淵說穎曰：「今二鎮跋扈，眾十餘萬，恐非宿衛及近郡士眾所能御也，請為殿下還說五部，以赴國難。」

translations.literal: When Wang Jun and the Duke of Dongying, Teng, raised troops, Yuan urged Ying, "The two garrisons now run riot, their forces more than one hundred thousand—I fear the palace guard and the troops of nearby commanderies cannot resist them. Please allow your servant to return and persuade the five tribes to come and meet the state's peril."
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Jun and the Duke of Dongying, Sima Teng, raised troops, Liu Yuan urged Ying, "The two garrisons now run riot, their forces more than one hundred thousand—I fear the palace guard and the troops of nearby commanderies cannot resist them. Please allow your servant to return and persuade the five tribes to come and meet the state's peril."

sentences.zh: 穎曰：「五部之眾，果可發否？

translations.literal: Ying said, "Can the forces of the five tribes truly be mobilized?
translations.idiomatic: Ying said, "Can the forces of the five tribes truly be mobilized?

sentences.zh: 就能發之，鮮卑、烏桓，未易當也。

translations.literal: Even if they can be mobilized, the Xianbei and Wuhuan will not be easy opponents.
translations.idiomatic: Even if they can be mobilized, the Xianbei and Wuhuan will not be easy opponents.

sentences.zh: 吾欲奉乘輿還洛陽以避其鋒，徐傳檄天下，以逆順制之，君意何如？」

translations.literal: I wish to escort the imperial carriage back to Luoyang to avoid their edge, gradually transmit proclamations throughout the realm, and control them by righteousness versus rebellion—what is your opinion?"
translations.idiomatic: I wish to escort the imperial carriage back to Luoyang to avoid their assault, gradually issue proclamations throughout the realm, and bring them to heel by the standard of righteousness versus rebellion—what do you think?"

sentences.zh: 淵曰：「殿下武皇帝之子，有大勳於王室，威恩遠著，四海之內，孰不願為殿下盡死力者！

translations.literal: Yuan said, "Your Highness is the son of Emperor Wu, you have great merit to the royal house, your authority and grace are renowned far and wide—within the four seas, who would not wish to exhaust his life and strength for Your Highness!
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuan said, "Your Highness is the son of Emperor Wu, you have rendered great service to the royal house, and your authority and grace are renowned far and wide—within the four seas, who would not wish to give his life for Your Highness!

sentences.zh: 何難發之！

translations.literal: What difficulty is there in mobilizing them!
translations.idiomatic: What difficulty could there be in mobilizing them!

sentences.zh: 王浚豎子，東嬴疏屬，豈能與殿下爭衡邪！

translations.literal: Wang Jun is a mere upstart, the Duke of Dongying is a distant collateral—how could they contend with Your Highness!
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun is a mere upstart, and the Duke of Dongying is a distant collateral—how could they possibly contend with Your Highness!

sentences.zh: 殿下一發鄴宮，示弱於人，洛陽不可得而至；

translations.literal: If Your Highness departs Ye Palace, you show weakness to others, and Luoyang cannot be reached;
translations.idiomatic: If Your Highness leaves Ye Palace, you will show weakness to the world, and Luoyang will be beyond reach;

sentences.zh: 雖至洛陽，威權不復在殿下也。

translations.literal: Even if you reach Luoyang, authority and power will no longer rest with Your Highness.
translations.idiomatic: Even if you reach Luoyang, authority and power will no longer rest with Your Highness.

sentences.zh: 願殿下撫勉士眾，靖以鎮之，淵請為殿下以二部摧東嬴，三部梟王浚，二豎之首，可指日而懸也。」

translations.literal: I wish Your Highness would comfort and encourage the soldiers and masses, and pacify and hold them with calm. Yuan requests to use two tribes to crush Dongying, and three tribes to decapitate Wang Jun—the heads of these two upstarts can be hung within days."
translations.idiomatic: I urge Your Highness to comfort and encourage your troops and hold the realm with calm authority. I ask leave to use two tribes to crush the Duke of Dongying and three tribes to take Wang Jun's head—the heads of these two upstarts can be hung within days."

sentences.zh: 穎悅，拜淵為北單于、參丞相軍事。

translations.literal: Ying was pleased and appointed Yuan as Northern Chanyu and Staff Officer under the Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Ying was pleased and appointed Liu Yuan Northern Chanyu and Staff Officer under the Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 淵至左國城，劉宣等上大單于之號，二旬之間，有眾五萬，都於離石，以聰為鹿蠡王。

translations.literal: When Yuan reached Zuoguo city, Liu Xuan and others raised him to the title of Grand Chanyu; within twenty days he had fifty thousand troops, established his capital at Lishi, and made Cong Prince of Luli.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Yuan reached Zuoguo city, Liu Xuan and others proclaimed him Grand Chanyu; within twenty days he had fifty thousand followers, established his capital at Lishi, and made Liu Cong Prince of Luli.

sentences.zh: 遣左於陸王宏帥精騎五千，會穎將王粹拒東嬴公騰。

translations.literal: He dispatched Left Yuliuchu Wang Hong to lead five thousand elite cavalry to join Ying's general Wang Cui in resisting the Duke of Dongying, Teng.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Left Yuliuchu Wang Hong to lead five thousand elite cavalry to join Sima Ying's general Wang Cui in resisting the Duke of Dongying, Sima Teng.

sentences.zh: 粹已為騰所敗，宏無及而歸。

translations.literal: Cui had already been defeated by Teng; Hong arrived too late and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cui had already been defeated by Teng; Hong arrived too late and returned.

sentences.zh: 王浚、東嬴公騰合兵擊王斌，大破之。

translations.literal: Wang Jun and the Duke of Dongying Teng combined forces to attack Wang Bin and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun and the Duke of Dongying, Sima Teng, combined forces to attack Wang Bin and routed him.

sentences.zh: 浚以主簿祁弘為前鋒，敗石超於平棘，乘勝進軍。

translations.literal: Jun made his Chief Clerk Qi Hong vanguard, defeated Shi Chao at Pingji, and pressed the attack in pursuit of victory.
translations.idiomatic: Jun made his Chief Clerk Qi Hong vanguard, defeated Shi Chao at Pingji, and pressed forward in pursuit of victory.

sentences.zh: 候騎至鄴，鄴中大震，百僚奔走，土卒分散。

translations.literal: Scout horsemen reached Ye; great panic swept Ye city, officials fled in all directions, and soldiers scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Scout horsemen reached Ye; panic swept the city, officials fled in all directions, and soldiers scattered.

sentences.zh: 盧志勸穎奉帝還洛陽。

translations.literal: Lu Zhi advised Ying to escort the Emperor back to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi urged Sima Ying to escort the Emperor back to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 時甲士尚有萬五千人，志夜部分，至曉將發，而程太妃戀鄴不欲去，穎狐疑未決。

translations.literal: At the time armed soldiers still numbered fifteen thousand; Zhi divided them by night, and by dawn they were about to depart—but the Lady of Cheng, the Empress Dowager, clung to Ye and did not wish to leave, and Ying hesitated, unable to decide.
translations.idiomatic: Armed soldiers still numbered fifteen thousand; Zhi organized them by night, and by dawn they were ready to depart—but the Lady of Cheng clung to Ye and did not wish to leave, and Ying wavered, unable to decide.

sentences.zh: 俄而眾潰，穎遂將帳下數十騎與志奉帝御犢車南奔洛陽。

translations.literal: Before long the masses dissolved; Ying then led several dozen horsemen of his personal guard with Zhi to escort the Emperor in an ox cart fleeing south to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the army dissolved; Ying then led several dozen horsemen of his personal guard with Zhi to escort the Emperor in an ox cart fleeing south to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 倉猝上下無繼，中黃門被囊中繼私錢三千，詔貸之，於道中買飯，夜則御中黃門布被，食以瓦盆。

translations.literal: In the haste, none of the court followed; a palace attendant named Ji from his purse took out three thousand in private coin, lent it by imperial decree, bought food along the road, and at night the Emperor used the palace attendant's cloth quilt and ate from an earthenware bowl.
translations.idiomatic: In the haste no one from the court followed; a palace attendant named Ji took three thousand in private coin from his purse, lent it by imperial decree to buy food along the road, and at night the Emperor slept under the attendant's cloth quilt and ate from an earthenware bowl.

sentences.zh: 至溫，將謁陵，帝喪履，納從者之履，下拜流涕。

translations.literal: Reaching Wen, about to visit the imperial tombs, the Emperor lost his shoes, put on a attendant's shoes, descended and bowed, weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Wen, as he was about to visit the imperial tombs, the Emperor lost his shoes, put on an attendant's shoes, descended, and bowed in tears.

sentences.zh: 及濟河，張方自洛陽遣其子羆帥騎三千，以所乘車奉迎帝。

translations.literal: When they crossed the river, Zhang Fang from Luoyang sent his son Pi leading three thousand cavalry, using his own carriage to welcome the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When they crossed the river, Zhang Fang sent his son Pi from Luoyang with three thousand cavalry, using his own carriage to welcome the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 至芒山下，方自帥萬餘騎迎帝。

translations.literal: Reaching below Mang Mountain, Fang personally led over ten thousand cavalry to welcome the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the foot of Mang Mountain, Fang personally led more than ten thousand cavalry to welcome the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 方將拜謁，帝下車自止之。

translations.literal: As Fang was about to bow in audience, the Emperor descended from the carriage and himself stopped him.
translations.idiomatic: As Fang was about to bow in audience, the Emperor descended from the carriage and stopped him himself.

sentences.zh: 帝還宮，奔散者稍還，百官粗備。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the palace; those who had fled gradually came back, and the officials were roughly assembled.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned to the palace; those who had fled gradually returned, and the officials were roughly reassembled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinsi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 王浚入鄴，士眾暴掠，死者甚眾。

translations.literal: When Wang Jun entered Ye, soldiers and masses plundered violently; very many died.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Jun entered Ye, his soldiers and followers plundered violently, and very many people died.

sentences.zh: 使烏桓羯朱追太弟穎，至朝歌，不及。

translations.literal: He sent Wuhuan and Jie Zhu to pursue the Grand Tutor Ying; they reached Chaoge but did not catch up.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the Wuhuan and Jie chieftain Zhu to pursue the Grand Tutor Ying; they reached Chaoge but failed to catch up.

sentences.zh: 浚還薊，以鮮卑多掠人婦女，命：「有敢挾藏者斬！」

translations.literal: Jun returned to Ji; because many of the Xianbei had seized people's women, he ordered: "Whoever dares hide them shall be beheaded!"
translations.idiomatic: Jun returned to Ji; because many Xianbei had seized people's wives and daughters, he ordered: "Whoever dares conceal them shall be beheaded!"

sentences.zh: 於是沈於易水者八千人。

translations.literal: Thereupon eight thousand people were drowned in the Yi River.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon eight thousand people were drowned in the Yi River.

sentences.zh: 東嬴公騰乞師於拓跋猗迤以擊劉淵，猗迤與弟猗盧合兵擊淵於西河，破之，與騰盟於汾東而還。

translations.literal: The Duke of Dongying Teng requested troops from Tuoba Yiyu to attack Liu Yuan; Yiyu combined forces with his brother Yilu to strike Yuan at Xihe, defeated him, allied with Teng at the east of the Fen River, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Dongying, Sima Teng, requested troops from Tuoba Yiyu to attack Liu Yuan; Yiyu combined forces with his brother Yilu to strike Yuan at Xihe, defeated him, allied with Teng east of the Fen River, and returned.

sentences.zh: 劉淵聞太弟穎去鄴，歎曰：「不用吾言，逆自奔潰，真奴才也！

translations.literal: When Liu Yuan heard that the Grand Tutor Ying had left Ye, he sighed and said: "He did not heed my words—he fled and collapsed on his own, a true slave!
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Yuan heard that the Grand Tutor Ying had left Ye, he sighed and said: "He did not heed my counsel—he fled and collapsed on his own, a true slave!

sentences.zh: 然吾與之有言矣，不可以不救。」

translations.literal: Yet I have words with him; I cannot fail to rescue him."
translations.idiomatic: Yet I gave him my word; I cannot fail to rescue him."

sentences.zh: 將發兵擊鮮卑、烏桓，劉宣等諫曰：「晉人奴隸御我，今其骨肉相殘，是天棄彼而使我復呼韓邪之業也。

translations.literal: He was about to send troops to attack the Xianbei and Wuhuan when Liu Xuan and others remonstrated: "The Jin people enslaved and controlled us; now their flesh and bone turn on one another—this is Heaven abandoning them and enabling us to restore the enterprise of Modu Chanyu.
translations.idiomatic: He was about to send troops against the Xianbei and Wuhuan when Liu Xuan and others remonstrated: "The Jin people enslaved and controlled us; now their own kin turn on one another—this is Heaven abandoning them and enabling us to restore the enterprise of Modu Chanyu.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑、烏桓，我之氣類，可以為援，奈何擊之！」

translations.literal: The Xianbei and Wuhuan are our kindred by nature and can serve as allies—how could we attack them!"
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei and Wuhuan are our kindred by nature and can serve as allies—how could we attack them!"

sentences.zh: 淵曰：「善！

translations.literal: Yuan said: "Good!
translations.idiomatic: Yuan said: "Well said!

sentences.zh: 大丈夫當為漢高、魏武，呼韓邪何足效哉！」

translations.literal: A great man should be like Emperor Gaozu of Han or Emperor Wu of Wei—what need is there to emulate Modu Chanyu!"
translations.idiomatic: A great man should be like Emperor Gaozu of Han or Emperor Wu of Wei—what need is there to emulate Modu Chanyu!"

sentences.zh: 宣等稽首曰：「非所及也！」

translations.literal: Xuan and the others bowed and said: "We cannot compare!"
translations.idiomatic: Xuan and the others bowed and said: "We are not equal to that!"

sentences.zh: 荊州兵擒斬張昌，同黨皆夷三族。

translations.literal: Jing province troops captured and beheaded Zhang Chang; his accomplices were all executed to the third degree of kin.
translations.idiomatic: Jing province troops captured and beheaded Zhang Chang; his accomplices were all executed to the third degree of kin.

sentences.zh: 李雄以范長生有名德，為蜀人所重，欲迎以為君而臣之，長生不可。

translations.literal: Li Xiong, because Fan Changsheng had fame and virtue and was respected by the people of Shu, wished to welcome him as ruler and himself serve as minister, but Changsheng would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiong, because Fan Changsheng enjoyed fame and virtue and was respected by the people of Shu, wished to welcome him as ruler and himself serve as minister, but Changsheng would not agree.

sentences.zh: 諸將固請雄即尊位。

translations.literal: The generals firmly petitioned Xiong to take the exalted position.
translations.idiomatic: The generals firmly urged Xiong to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，雄即成都王位，大赦，改元曰建興。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Xiong assumed the kingship of Chengdu, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Jianxing.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Xiong assumed the kingship of Chengdu, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Jianxing.

sentences.zh: 除晉法，約法七章。

translations.literal: He abolished Jin law and established a simplified code of seven articles.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished Jin law and established a simplified code of seven articles.

sentences.zh: 以其叔父驤為太傅，兄始為太保，李離為太尉，李雲為司徒，李璜為司空，李國為太宰，閻式為尚書令，楊褒為僕射。

translations.literal: He appointed his uncle Xiang as Grand Tutor, elder brother Shi as Grand Guardian, Li Li as Grand Commandant, Li Yun as Minister over the Masses, Li Huang as Minister of Works, Li Guo as Grand Preceptor, Yan Shi as Director of the Masters of Writing, Yang Bao as Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed his uncle Li Xiang Grand Tutor, his elder brother Li Shi Grand Guardian, Li Li Grand Commandant, Li Yun Minister over the Masses, Li Huang Minister of Works, Li Guo Grand Preceptor, Yan Shi Director of the Masters of Writing, and Yang Bao Deputy Director.

sentences.zh: 尊母羅氏為王太后，追尊父特為成都景王。

translations.literal: He honored his mother Lady Luo as Queen Dowager and posthumously honored his father Te as King Jing of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: He honored his mother Lady Luo as Queen Dowager and posthumously honored his father Li Te as King Jing of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 雄以李國、李離有智謀，凡事必咨而後行，然國、離事雄彌謹。

translations.literal: Xiong, because Li Guo and Li Li had wisdom and stratagem, consulted them on every matter before acting; yet Guo and Li served Xiong with ever greater care.
translations.idiomatic: Because Li Guo and Li Li were wise and resourceful, Xiong consulted them on every matter before acting; yet Guo and Li served him with ever greater care.

sentences.zh: 劉淵遷都左國城，胡、晉歸之者愈眾。

translations.literal: Liu Yuan moved his capital to Zuoguo city; barbarians and Jin people who submitted to him grew ever more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuan moved his capital to Zuoguo city, and ever more barbarians and Jin subjects came to join him.

sentences.zh: 淵謂群臣曰：「昔漢有天下久長，恩結於民。

translations.literal: Yuan said to his ministers: "Formerly Han held the realm long; its grace bound the people.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan said to his ministers: "Formerly Han held the realm for a long age, and its grace bound the people.

sentences.zh: 吾，漢氏之甥，約為兄弟。

translations.literal: I am a nephew of the House of Han; we were pledged as brothers.
translations.idiomatic: I am a nephew of the House of Han; we were pledged as brothers.

sentences.zh: 兄亡弟紹，不亦可乎！」

translations.literal: When the elder brother dies the younger succeeds—is that not fitting!"
translations.idiomatic: When the elder brother dies, the younger succeeds—is that not fitting!"

sentences.zh: 乃建國號曰漢。

translations.literal: Thereupon he established the state name Han.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he established the state name Han.

sentences.zh: 劉宣等請上尊號，淵曰：「今四方未定，且可依高祖稱漢王。」

translations.literal: Liu Xuan and others requested he take the exalted title; Yuan said: "The four quarters are not yet settled; for now let us follow Gaozu and style ourselves King of Han."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xuan and others asked him to take the exalted title; Yuan said: "The four quarters are not yet settled; for now let us follow Gaozu and style ourselves King of Han."

sentences.zh: 於是即漢王位，大赦，改元曰元熙。

translations.literal: Thereupon he assumed the kingship of Han, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Yuanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he assumed the kingship of Han, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Yuanxi.

sentences.zh: 追尊安樂公禪為孝懷皇帝，作漢三祖、五宗神主而祭之。

translations.literal: He posthumously honored Duke Shan of Anle as Emperor Xiaohuai, made spirit tablets of the Three Ancestors and Five August Ancestors of Han and offered sacrifice to them.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored Duke Shan of Anle as Emperor Xiaohuai, made spirit tablets of the Three Ancestors and Five August Ancestors of Han, and offered sacrifice to them.

sentences.zh: 立其妻呼延氏為王后。

translations.literal: He installed his wife Lady Huyan as queen.
translations.idiomatic: He installed his wife Lady Huyan as queen.

sentences.zh: 以右賢王宣為丞相，崔游為御史大夫，左於陸王宏為太尉，范隆為大鴻臚，朱紀為太常，上常崔懿之、後部人陳元達皆為黃門郎，族子曜為建武將軍；

translations.literal: He appointed Right Worthy King Xuan as Chancellor, Cui You as Grand Censor, Left Yuliuchu Wang Hong as Grand Commandant, Fan Long as Grand Herald, Zhu Ji as Grand Minister of Ceremonies, Senior Attendant Cui Yizhi and Rear Tribe native Chen Yuanda both as Palace Attendants, and his clansman Yao as General Who Establishes Martial Might;
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Right Worthy King Liu Xuan Chancellor, Cui You Grand Censor, Left Yuliuchu Wang Hong Grand Commandant, Fan Long Grand Herald, Zhu Ji Grand Minister of Ceremonies, Senior Attendant Cui Yizhi and Rear Tribe native Chen Yuanda both Palace Attendants, and his clansman Liu Yao General Who Establishes Martial Might;

sentences.zh: 游固辭不就。

translations.literal: You firmly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: You firmly declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 元達少有志操，淵嘗招之，元達不答。

translations.literal: Yuanda from youth had aspiration and integrity; Yuan once invited him, but Yuanda did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanda from youth had aspiration and integrity; Yuan once invited him, but Yuanda did not respond.

sentences.zh: 及淵為漢王，或謂元達曰：「君其懼乎？」

translations.literal: When Yuan became King of Han, someone said to Yuanda: "Are you not afraid?"
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan became King of Han, someone said to Yuanda: "Are you not afraid?"

sentences.zh: 元達笑曰：「吾知其人久矣，彼亦亮吾之心；

translations.literal: Yuanda laughed and said: "I have known that man long; he also understands my heart;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanda laughed and said: "I have known that man long; he also understands my heart;

sentences.zh: 但恐不過三、二日，驛書必至。」

translations.literal: I only fear that within two or three days an urgent letter will surely arrive."
translations.idiomatic: I only fear that within two or three days an urgent summons will surely arrive."

sentences.zh: 其暮，淵果征元達。

translations.literal: That evening, Yuan indeed summoned Yuanda.
translations.idiomatic: That evening, Yuan indeed summoned Yuanda.

sentences.zh: 元達事淵，屢進忠言，退而削草，雖子弟莫得知也。

translations.literal: Yuanda served Yuan, repeatedly offering loyal counsel; when he withdrew he destroyed his drafts, so even his sons and brothers did not know of it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanda served Yuan, repeatedly offering loyal counsel; when he withdrew he destroyed his drafts, so even his sons and brothers did not know of it.

sentences.zh: 曜生而眉白，目有赤光，幼聰慧，有膽量，早孤，養於淵。

translations.literal: Yao was born with white eyebrows and red light in his eyes; in youth he was clever and had courage; orphaned early, he was reared by Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yao was born with white eyebrows and a red gleam in his eyes; in youth he was clever and courageous; orphaned early, he was reared by Yuan.

sentences.zh: 及長，儀觀魁偉，性拓落高亮，與眾不群。

translations.literal: When grown, his bearing was imposing and tall; his nature was expansive and lofty, unlike the crowd.
translations.idiomatic: When grown, his bearing was imposing and tall; his nature was expansive and lofty, and he stood apart from the crowd.

sentences.zh: 好讀書，善屬文，鐵厚一寸，射而洞之。

translations.literal: He loved reading and was skilled at composition; he could pierce an inch-thick iron plate with an arrow.
translations.idiomatic: He loved reading and was skilled at composition; he could pierce an inch-thick iron plate with an arrow.

sentences.zh: 常自比樂毅及蕭、曹，時人莫之許也；

translations.literal: He often compared himself to Yue Yi and to Xiao He and Cao Shen, but people of the time did not agree;
translations.idiomatic: He often compared himself to Yue Yi and to Xiao He and Cao Shen, but people of the time did not agree;

sentences.zh: 惟劉聰重之，曰：「永明，漢世祖、魏武之流，數公何足道哉！」

translations.literal: Only Liu Cong valued him, saying: "Yongming is of the caliber of Emperor Guangwu of Han and Emperor Wu of Wei—those others are hardly worth mentioning!"
translations.idiomatic: Only Liu Cong valued him, saying: "Yongming is of the caliber of Emperor Guangwu of Han and Emperor Wu of Wei—those others are hardly worth mentioning!"

sentences.zh: 帝既還洛陽，張方擁兵專制朝政，太弟穎不得復豫事。

translations.literal: The Emperor having returned to Luoyang, Zhang Fang monopolized military power and controlled court affairs; the Grand Tutor Ying could no longer participate in government.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Emperor had returned to Luoyang, Zhang Fang monopolized military power and controlled court affairs, and the Grand Tutor Ying could no longer participate in government.

sentences.zh: 豫州都督范陽王虓、徐州都督東平王楙等上言：「穎弗克負荷，宜降封一邑，特全其命。

translations.literal: The Governor of Yuzhou, the Prince of Fanyang Xiao, the Governor of Xuzhou, the Prince of Dongping Mao, and others memorialized: "Ying cannot bear the burden; he should be demoted in rank to one fief and his life especially spared.
translations.idiomatic: The Governor of Yuzhou, the Prince of Fanyang Sima Xiao, the Governor of Xuzhou, the Prince of Dongping Sima Mao, and others memorialized: "Ying cannot bear the burden; he should be demoted to a lesser fief and his life especially spared.

sentences.zh: 太宰宜委以關右之任，自州郡以下，選舉授任，一皆仰成；

translations.literal: The Grand Preceptor should be entrusted with the responsibilities west of the passes; from the provinces and commanderies downward, selection and appointment of office—let all be completed through him;
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Preceptor should be entrusted with responsibilities west of the passes; from the provinces and commanderies downward, selection and appointment should all be completed through him;

sentences.zh: 朝之大事，廢興損益，每輒疇咨。

translations.literal: In great affairs of state, abolition and establishment, loss and gain—each time consult with him.
translations.idiomatic: In great affairs of state, whether to abolish or establish, to lose or to gain—each time consult with him.

sentences.zh: 張方為國效節，而不達變通，未即西還，宜遣還郡，所加方官，請悉如舊。

translations.literal: Zhang Fang has served the state with loyalty but does not understand flexible adaptation; he has not yet returned west—he should be sent back to his commandery, and all offices added for Fang should be restored as before, we request.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang has served the state loyally but does not understand flexible adaptation; he has not yet returned west—he should be sent back to his commandery, and all offices added for Fang should be restored as before, we request.

sentences.zh: 司徒戎、司空越，並忠國小心，宜干機事，委以朝政。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Rong and Minister of Works Yue are both loyal to the state and careful; they should manage urgent affairs and be entrusted with court government.
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses Wang Rong and Minister of Works Sima Yue are both loyal to the state and careful; they should manage urgent affairs and be entrusted with court government.

sentences.zh: 王浚有定社稷之勳，宜特崇重，遂撫幽朔，長為北籓。

translations.literal: Wang Jun has the merit of settling the altars of soil and grain; he should be especially honored and esteemed, and entrusted to pacify You and Shuo, long to serve as the northern bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun has the merit of settling the altars of soil and grain; he should be especially honored and entrusted to pacify You and Shuo as a lasting northern bulwark.

sentences.zh: 臣等竭力扞城，籓屏皇家，則陛下垂拱，四海自正矣。」

translations.literal: We your ministers will exert our strength in defending the cities and shielding the imperial house—then Your Majesty may rule with folded hands and the four seas will naturally be set right."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers will exert our strength in defending the cities and shielding the imperial house—then Your Majesty may rule with folded hands and the four seas will naturally be set right."

sentences.zh: 張方在洛既久，兵士剽掠殆竭，眾情喧喧，無復留意，議欲奉帝遷都長安；

translations.literal: Zhang Fang having been in Luoyang long, soldiers plundered until nearly exhausted; public sentiment was clamorous with no further care, and they discussed escorting the Emperor to move the capital to Chang'an;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang having been in Luoyang a long time, his soldiers plundered until nearly nothing remained; public sentiment grew clamorous and restless, and they discussed escorting the Emperor to move the capital to Chang'an;

sentences.zh: 恐帝及公卿不從，欲須帝出而劫之。

translations.literal: Fearing the Emperor and the high officials would not comply, they wished to wait for the Emperor to come out and then seize him.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the Emperor and the high officials would not comply, they planned to wait for the Emperor to come out and then seize him.

sentences.zh: 乃請帝謁廟，帝不許。

translations.literal: He thereupon requested the Emperor to visit the ancestral temple; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon requested the Emperor to visit the ancestral temple; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 十一月，乙未，方引兵入殿，以所乘車迎帝，帝馳避後園竹中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yimao, Fang led troops into the palace, using his own carriage to welcome the Emperor; the Emperor galloped to hide in the bamboo grove of the rear garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day yimao, Fang led troops into the palace and used his own carriage to welcome the Emperor; the Emperor galloped to hide in the bamboo grove of the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 軍人引帝出，逼使上車，帝垂泣從之。

translations.literal: Soldiers pulled the Emperor out, forced him to mount the carriage; the Emperor wept as he followed.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers pulled the Emperor out and forced him into the carriage; the Emperor wept as he complied.

sentences.zh: 方於馬上稽首曰：「今寇賊縱橫，宿衛單少，願陛下幸臣壘，臣盡死力以備不虞。」

translations.literal: Fang on horseback bowed and said: "Now bandits and rebels run rampant, palace guards are few—Your Majesty, I wish you would honor my camp; your servant will exhaust his life in strength to guard against the unforeseen."
translations.idiomatic: Fang bowed from horseback and said: "Bandits and rebels now run rampant, and the palace guard is thin—Your Majesty, I beg you to honor my camp; your servant will give his life to guard against the unforeseen."

sentences.zh: 時群臣皆逃匿，唯中書監盧志侍側，曰：「陛下今日之事，當一從右將軍。」

translations.literal: At the time all the officials had fled and hidden; only Director of the Secretariat Lu Zhi attended at his side and said: "In today's affairs, Your Majesty should fully follow the Right General."
translations.idiomatic: At the time all the officials had fled and hidden; only Director of the Secretariat Lu Zhi attended at his side and said: "In today's affairs, Your Majesty should fully follow the Right General."

sentences.zh: 帝遂幸方壘，令方具車載宮人、寶物。

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon went to Fang's camp and ordered Fang to prepare carriages to load palace women and treasures.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thereupon went to Fang's camp and ordered Fang to prepare carriages to load palace women and treasures.

sentences.zh: 軍人因妻略後宮，分爭府藏，割流蘇、武帳為馬帴，魏、晉以來蓄積，掃地無遺。

translations.literal: Soldiers took wives from the inner palace and plundered, divided and fought over the treasury stores, cut tassels and military awnings for horse blankets—accumulations since Wei and Jin were swept clean without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers seized women from the inner palace and plundered the treasury, fighting over the stores and cutting tassels and military awnings for horse blankets—accumulations since Wei and Jin were swept clean.

sentences.zh: 方將焚宗廟、宮室以絕人返顧之心，盧志曰：「昔董卓無道，焚燒洛陽，怨毒之聲，百年猶存，何為襲之！」
