translations.literal: Fang was about to burn the ancestral temple and palace halls to cut off any impulse in people to look back, when Lu Zhi said: "Formerly Dong Zhuo was without the Way and burned Luoyang—the voice of grievance and hatred endures even after a century—why repeat it!"
translations.idiomatic: Fang was about to burn the ancestral temple and palace halls to cut off any impulse to look back, when Lu Zhi said: "Formerly Dong Zhuo was without the Way and burned Luoyang—the voice of grievance and hatred endures even after a century—why repeat it!"

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: He thereupon stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon stopped.

sentences.zh: 帝停方壘三日，方擁帝及太弟穎、豫章王熾等趨長安，王戎出奔郟。

translations.literal: The Emperor stayed at Fang's camp three days; Fang escorted the Emperor and the Grand Tutor Ying, the Prince of Yuzhang Chi, and others hurrying to Chang'an; Wang Rong fled to Jia.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor stayed at Fang's camp three days; Fang then escorted the Emperor, the Grand Tutor Ying, the Prince of Yuzhang Chi, and others toward Chang'an; Wang Rong fled to Jia.

sentences.zh: 太宰顒帥官屬步騎三萬迎於霸上，顒前拜謁，帝下車止之。

translations.literal: The Grand Preceptor Yong led officials, foot and cavalry thirty thousand, to welcome at Bashang; Yong bowed in audience first, the Emperor descended from the carriage to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Preceptor Sima Yong led thirty thousand foot and cavalry with his officials to welcome them at Bashang; Yong bowed in audience first, and the Emperor descended from the carriage to stop him.

sentences.zh: 帝入長安，以征西府為宮。

translations.literal: The Emperor entered Chang'an and used the Western Expedition headquarters as palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor entered Chang'an and used the Western Expedition headquarters as his palace.

sentences.zh: 唯尚書僕射荀籓、司隸劉暾、河南尹周馥等在洛陽為留臺，承制行事，號東、西臺。

translations.literal: Only Secretary Deputy Director Xun Fan, Director of Retainers Liu Tun, Intendant of Henan Zhou Fu, and others remained at Luoyang as the residual court, acting by imperial authority—these were called the Eastern and Western courts.
translations.idiomatic: Only Secretary Deputy Director Xun Fan, Director of Retainers Liu Tun, Intendant of Henan Zhou Fu, and others remained at Luoyang as the residual court, acting by imperial authority—these were called the Eastern and Western courts.

sentences.zh: 籓，勖之子也。

translations.literal: Fan was the son of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Fan was the son of Xun Xu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，留臺大赦，改元復為永安。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the residual court proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name back to Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, the residual court proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name back to Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復皇后羊氏。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Empress Yang was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, Empress Yang was restored.

sentences.zh: 羅尚移屯巴郡，遣兵掠蜀中，獲李驤妻昝氏及子壽。

translations.literal: Luo Shang shifted his garrison to Ba commandery, dispatched troops to plunder central Shu, and captured Li Xiang's wife Lady Zan and son Shou.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shang shifted his garrison to Ba commandery, dispatched troops to plunder central Shu, and captured Li Xiang's wife Lady Zan and son Shou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁亥，詔太弟穎以成都王還第；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dinghai, an edict ordered the Grand Tutor Ying to return to his residence as Prince of Chengdu;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day dinghai, an edict ordered the Grand Tutor Ying to return to his residence as Prince of Chengdu;

sentences.zh: 更立豫章王熾為皇太弟。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yuzhang Chi was newly installed as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yuzhang Chi was newly installed as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 帝兄弟二十五人，時存者惟穎、熾及吳王晏。

translations.literal: The Emperor had twenty-five brothers; at this time only Ying, Chi, and the Prince of Wu Yan survived.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had twenty-five brothers; at this time only Ying, Chi, and the Prince of Wu Yan survived.

sentences.zh: 晏材質庸下；

translations.literal: Yan's talent and quality were mediocre and low;
translations.idiomatic: Yan's talent and character were mediocre;

sentences.zh: 熾沖素好學，故太宰顒立之。

translations.literal: Chi Chong had always loved learning; therefore Grand Tutor Yong installed him.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Chi, styled Chong, had always loved learning; for that reason Sima Yong, the grand tutor, chose him.

sentences.zh: 詔以司空越為太傅，與顒夾輔帝室，王戎參錄朝政。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Minister of Works Yue as Grand Tutor to assist the imperial house together with Yong; Wang Rong participated in recording court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Sima Yue, minister of works, grand tutor to assist the throne alongside Yong, with Wang Rong taking part in the governance of court affairs.

sentences.zh: 又以光祿大夫王衍為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Wang Yan was further appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan was also appointed grand master of splendid happiness and left vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 高密王略為鎮南將軍，領司隸校尉，權鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: Prince of Gaomi Lue was made General Who Guards the South, concurrently Colonel Director of Retainers, with provisional authority to garrison Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Lue, Prince of Gaomi, was made general who guards the south and colonel director of retainers, with provisional authority to hold Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 東中郎將模為寧北將軍，都督冀州諸軍事，鎮鄴。

translations.literal: Eastern Central Commander of the Gentlemen Mo was made General Who Pacifies the North, Commander-in-Chief of all Jizhou military affairs, garrisoning Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Mo, eastern central commander of the gentlemen, was made general who pacifies the north and commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Ji Province, with his seat at Ye.

sentences.zh: 百官各還本職。

translations.literal: The hundred officials each returned to their original posts.
translations.idiomatic: All officials were restored to their proper posts.

sentences.zh: 令州郡蠲除苛政，愛民務本，清通之後，當還東京。

translations.literal: It ordered the provinces and commanderies to abolish harsh government, cherish the people and attend to fundamentals, and that after the roads were cleared they should return to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The provinces and commanderies were ordered to abolish harsh rule, cherish the people, and attend to the fundamentals of government; once the roads were safe again, the court would return to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 略、模，皆越之弟也。

translations.literal: Lue and Mo were both younger brothers of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Lue and Mo were both younger brothers of Sima Yue.

sentences.zh: 王浚既去鄴，越使模鎮之。

translations.literal: After Wang Jun had left Ye, Yue sent Mo to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: After Wang Jun left Ye, Sima Yue sent Sima Mo to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 顒以四方乖離，禍難不已，故下此詔和解之，冀獲少安。

translations.literal: Yong, because the four quarters were estranged and calamities unceasing, therefore issued this edict to reconcile them, hoping to gain a little peace.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yong, seeing the realm torn apart and disasters unending, issued this edict in the hope of reconciliation and a little breathing room.

sentences.zh: 越辭太傅不受。

translations.literal: Yue declined the post of Grand Tutor and would not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yue declined the grand tutorship and refused to accept it.

sentences.zh: 又詔以太宰顒都督中外諸軍事。

translations.literal: Another edict appointed Grand Tutor Yong Commander-in-Chief of all armies within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict named the grand tutor Yong commander-in-chief of all armies within and without.

sentences.zh: 張方為中領軍、錄尚書事，領京兆太守。

translations.literal: Zhang Fang was made Central Army Commander, Recorder of the Masters of Writing affairs, and concurrently Administrator of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang was made central army commander and recorder of the Masters of Writing, while also serving as administrator of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 東嬴公騰遣將軍聶玄擊漢王淵，戰於大陵，玄兵大敗。

translations.literal: Duke of Dongying Teng sent General Nie Xuan to attack Han King Yuan; they fought at Daling and Xuan's army was utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Teng, Duke of Dongying, sent the general Nie Xuan against Liu Yuan, king of Han. They fought at Daling, and Xuan's army was routed.

sentences.zh: 淵遣劉曜寇太原，取泫氏、屯留、長子、中都。

translations.literal: Yuan sent Liu Yao to raid Taiyuan, taking Xuan, Tunliu, Changzi, and Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuan sent Liu Yao to raid Taiyuan and seize Xuan, Tunliu, Changzi, and Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 又遣冠軍將軍喬晞寇西河，取介休。

translations.literal: He further sent Champion General Qiao Xi to raid Xihe and take Jiexiu.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent the champion general Qiao Xi against Xihe, who took Jiexiu.

sentences.zh: 介休令賈渾不降，晞殺之；

translations.literal: Jiexiu Magistrate Jia Hun would not surrender; Xi killed him;
translations.idiomatic: Jia Hun, magistrate of Jiexiu, refused to submit, and Qiao Xi killed him;

sentences.zh: 將納其妻宗氏，宗氏罵晞而哭，日晞又殺之。

translations.literal: he was about to take Hun's wife Lady Zong; Lady Zong cursed Xi and wept, and on that day Xi killed her too.
translations.idiomatic: he was about to take Hun's wife, Lady Zong. She cursed Qiao Xi and wept, and that same day he killed her as well.

sentences.zh: 淵聞之，大怒曰：「使天道有知，喬晞望有種乎！」

translations.literal: Yuan heard of it and said in great anger: "If Heaven's Way has knowledge, will Qiao Xi hope to leave descendants!"
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Yuan heard of it, he flew into a rage. "If Heaven has eyes," he said, "may Qiao Xi's line be cut off!"

sentences.zh: 追還，降秩四等，收渾屍，葬之。

translations.literal: He recalled Xi, reduced his rank by four grades, gathered Hun's corpse, and buried it.
translations.idiomatic: He recalled Qiao Xi, reduced his rank by four grades, recovered Jia Hun's body, and gave it proper burial.
